entry: StackedPairs.init(target, options)  // target = container el or selector (default '#pairs'); reads existing .pair markup or builds it from options.slides. options all optional.
rules: NOT a pinned stepper: a VERTICAL RHYTHM of distinct full-screen sections, each = TEXT on the LEFT (~38%) + a BIG contained RENDER on the RIGHT (~62%); you scroll from one PAIR to the NEXT
NO pin, NO swap, NO clip — owns_pin is FALSE; the reveal is per-section, not a pinned timeline

frs7 composition per pair: text LEFT ~38%, BIG contained fixed-size render RIGHT ~62% (84vh, rounded-left frame), ~2cm gap, a thin bronze rule on the far-left text edge, an index eyebrow + Fraunces serif heading (italic-bronze keyword) + sub, a small tag bottom-right of the render; the render is ALWAYS on the right

each section reveals AS IT ENTERS the viewport via a PURE render(self.progress): the render rises (y 46->0) + fades (opacity 0->1, the IMG stays opaque), the bronze rule fades+grows (scaleY 0.6->1), the text bits rise in a gentle air-eased stagger; reveal completes by ~revealSpan of the travel then HOLDS while centred

a SLOW continuous MONOTONIC ken-burns runs on the render while the section is on screen (scale 1.06 -> 1.12, ease none) on a SEPARATE trigger (top bottom -> bottom top); image-only, never resets, never blanks
reverse-safe: scrubbing back runs the SAME pure render(progress) backward

DO NOT use toggleActions: the first frs11 used a toggleActions tween and it FAILED to fire on load (in-view sections never got their enter callback); the FIX is the pure scrubbed render(progress) + an init paint at load. Reintroducing toggleActions is the bug.

TWO ScrollTriggers per section, BOTH scrub:true, NEITHER pins: (1) reveal start 'top 85%' end 'top 35%' onUpdate render; an init trigger paints once at load then is killed. (2) ken-burns start 'top bottom' end 'bottom top' fromTo scale
ONE smoother: Lenis 1.1.13 lerp 0.1 smoothWheel -> gsap.ticker -> ScrollTrigger.update; lagSmoothing(0); no raw native scrub
transform / opacity ONLY — no WebGL, no mask-composite, no mix-blend / backdrop over the scrubbed surface, no video.currentTime
reduced-motion / <=820px => static legible stack (no Lenis, no triggers); on narrow the render stacks ABOVE the text (order:-1)

slides.meaning: the pairs [{src,tag,idx,title,sub,objPos}]; used ONLY to BUILD pairs when the target container is empty; else the faithful frs11 6-render deck (DEFAULT_SLIDES). If the target already holds .pair markup it is used verbatim.

revealStart.meaning: reveal trigger start — progress 0 when the section top hits 85% of the viewport

revealEnd.meaning: reveal trigger end — progress 1 when the section top reaches 35% (as it rises into view)

kenStart.meaning: ken-burns trigger start — the section's full pass through the viewport begins

kenEnd.meaning: ken-burns trigger end — the section has fully passed; the scale is monotonic across this travel and never resets

kenFrom.meaning: ken-burns image scale at the start of the pass

kenTo.meaning: ken-burns image scale at the end of the pass (slow, continuous, monotonic)

revealSpan.meaning: fraction of the reveal travel over which the render+bar reveal completes; after this it HOLDS while the section is centred

textSpan.meaning: fraction of the reveal travel over which each text bit (index, title, sub) reveals; each bit is offset to a slightly later slice for the stagger

manageLenis.meaning: true = the component owns Lenis + gsap.ticker -> ScrollTrigger.update; false = the caller already runs the smoother (one Lenis per page) and the component only wires its triggers

accent.meaning: the bronze accent (far-left rule, the italic keyword, the index eyebrow)
